rule: Each call in a multi-line method chain is reported on the line of its own method name, not the chain's first line. | **C7 Complete edges.** Caller and callee are never empty. The line is the line of the callee's name, per the ID-format rules.
notes: Layout: src/ (the scan root) holds a Cargo package, Cargo.toml plus src/*.rs, so module paths are crate-relative. Each link sits on its own name's line. std::env::args is a std path → medium; later links are on call results typed only by std → .skip/.filter/.count low. The anonymous closure folds into count_flags; its parameter a has no declared type → a.starts_with low. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (including path calls Type::assoc()) and direct for free functions, module-path functions and named nested functions.
